content: Ceŋe goɗɗe ɗe poondi ɗum ngoni: sinima ɓurnga moƴƴugo, hoosiyanɗo sinima ɓurɗo moƴƴugo, nastugo sinima (cinématographie) ɓurngo moƴƴugo, lummbe ɓurɗe moƴƴugo, tammbitaago sinima ɓurngo moƴƴugo, kosol gimol aaw-mum ɓurngol moƴƴugo, kuutinirɗe ɓurɗe moƴƴugo, tammbitaago ndaar-jaŋde ɓurngo moƴƴugo, ɗon-ɗoftaago ɓurngo moƴƴugo e winndere sinima aaw-mum ɓurnde moƴƴugo.
